GRESSROOTS • CLIENT SOLUTION EXPLORER • 19 NOV 2026

From answer sheets to decisions that improve preparation.

3i Academic Intelligence is an institutional assessment-intelligence layer: ingest papers, evaluate against an uploaded rubric, detect classroom patterns and calculate a transparent, per-student study-priority list. This experience demonstrates the full proposed journey — not a deployed product.

THE BUSINESS OUTCOME

The product is not “just AI grading.”

The BRD's differentiator is helping a teacher decide which student needs help, which concepts failed, which intervention to use and which topics deserve the next study hour. Every technical layer must support that decision without losing traceability to the original paper.

01

Student insight

Estimated marks, 5–10 topic mastery scores, 2–3 strengths, gaps, nudges and an urgency classification.

BRD §§5–6.3
02

Cohort intelligence

Shared errors, batch ranking, at-risk list and teaching actions, always showing the analysed denominator.

BRD §6.3
03

Study ROI

Rank a reproducible top-five, estimate required effort, factor in chapter weightage and days remaining, and explain deferrals.

BRD §§6.4,8.3
Design boundaries that matter

Not an LMS, content repository, lesson-plan author, question-bank generator, tutor or live teaching service. MVP is document-first. Voice, multi-test trend analysis, optional student portal and advanced error intelligence are later / disputed scope items.

Proposed architecture ≠ approved build

ACTUAL SIGNAL PATHS

Trace the wires from trigger to outcome.

Switch flows. Each connected block is clickable and opens that component's technical definition above.

FORWARD PATH

Request + processing

Web → authenticated API → presigned S3 object → submission metadata → SQS → worker → OCR → question map → rubric evaluation → group synthesis → ROI → PDF.

RETURN PATH

Results + review

Student/cohort versions in PostgreSQL → role-filtered API → faculty dashboard → reviewed PDF → approved delivery. A rubric correction creates new downstream versions without mandatory re-OCR.

CONTROL PATH

Privacy + quality

RLS across tenant records; KMS encrypted storage, region-aware AI requests, redacted traces, OCR review queue, idempotency and DLQ, cost/accuracy monitoring and deletion workflow.

CORE PRODUCT DIFFERENTIATOR

Preparation ROI — a transparent calculation lab.

Try how the top-five, four quadrants and time-to-exam mode react to inputs. The mathematics is an illustrative deterministic prototype: topic weights, hours, coefficients and potential score gains are fabricated for UI testing, not calibrated NEET forecasts or approved client formula parameters.

BRD §6.4: ROI = chapter weightage × mark-gain potential ÷ estimated effort hours. BRD §8.3.2 additionally specifies a time-decay factor. This demo uses visible illustrative factors; the canonical formula and source data require approval.

DOCUMENT BASIS

Sources inspected

TECHNICAL FEASIBILITY WATCHLIST

What current provider documentation changes

  • Claude via Amazon Bedrock India: AWS announced Claude India geographic cross-region inference across Mumbai and Hyderabad in September 2026; verify exact available model, inference profile and account access before use.
  • Google Vision OCR: publicly documented regional OCR endpoints are US/EU; an India-only processing claim cannot be inferred from Mumbai-hosted S3 data.
  • Amazon Textract: OCR language capabilities have expanded, but exact handwritten English and Indian-script accuracy, feature availability and per-page cost must be benchmarked for the input corpus.
  • Privacy: default vendor retention, model invocation logging, subprocessor, consent, WhatsApp and deletion conditions must be verified separately; do not assume equivalent ZDR across vendor routes.
  • DPDP: BRD claims are client expectations, not a legal opinion. Legal counsel should approve applicability and the distinction between law and contractual India-only commitments.
No internet or API connections exist in this presentation. Technical research is contextual and may change before engineering procurement; external links/contact routes intentionally omitted for safe client circulation.
